newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CEN BANK SAYS NO BOARD MEETING ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CEN BANK SAYS NO BOARD MEETING ON THURSDAY.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Thursday that there would be no meeting of its board today.
The central bank usually holds board meetings on Thursdays on a bi-weekly basis but the recent crisis in the crown has made the sessions unpredictable.
The CNB said that market rumours that it had planned to hold a board meeting this Thursday were unfounded.
